scientific_integrity: Published definitions are attributed; analytic derivations and finite checker are distinguished; earlier specialized literature coverage remains a documented uncertainty.
scientific_limitations: The fixed positive denominator floor, final-only correction (25), two constant-rate reversible compartments, two-stage SDIRK predictor and exact arithmetic are essential. The global convergence claim concerns the modified limiting ODE, not the original ODE; no generalization to stagewise correction or epsilon(h)->0.
title: Fixed-floor Patankar correction: exact shadow dynamics and a three-regime equilibrium bias
